label_schema.rule: A row labelled `requirement` has an expected verdict+exit that is DERIVED FROM THE SPEC TEXT: two independent seats reading SPEC.md derive the same expected value before running. A row labelled `documented_choice` is a place SPEC.md does not uniquely fix the outcome; the expected value follows a documented implementer choice (README 'five boundaries' / the reference's own convention) and two seats may legitimately differ. The label is an ASSERTION by this seat; the derived class is the verdicts two seats actually produce on re-run (the labeled-vs-derived table).

labels.requirement: expected value derivable from SPEC.md alone by any seat
labels.documented_choice: SPEC.md silent/underdetermined; expected value is a documented implementer choice
